responsibility: Implements LONGREAL text I/O over IOChan channels. It uses LongConv’s scanner semantics, TextUtil space skipping, dynamic string accumulation, and strtold parsing to read numeric tokens while setting per-channel ReadResults, and it formats output by calling ConvStringLong helpers and StringChan field-width writers, providing the concrete text-stream I/O layer for long real values.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for LongIO: it contains the actual LONGREAL channel scanner/formatter logic using LongConv, strtold, ConvStringLong, and StringChan, whereas LongIO.def only publishes the procedure signatures and semantics.
